verdict.rationale: AutoGen has a dedicated human-in-the-loop tutorial. Its built-in UserProxyAgent acts as a proxy for a user to give feedback to a running team. AutoGen Studio adds run control that can pause or stop execution, and a community user credits AutoGen with keeping the human in the loop to assist agents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of approval-gating (approve/reject before an action proceeds), documented mechanics for resuming a paused run with the human's decision, and hands-on corroboration of mid-run pause/resume.
